comment: The pinned orchard release. Edited only by a deliberate update, never to silence a failure. assets[] are download hashes and change when an archive is repacked; files[] are content hashes and change only when the words do. v1.1.0 changed every archive hash and no content hash. v1.8.0 is the slur supplement finished and sourced: 112 words denied, so enable.txt, scowl95-additions.txt and beyond-size-70.txt move and common-pool.txt and beyond-size-95.txt do not; two curated definitions, fagot and sulla, move definitions.tsv and gloss-provenance.tsv; dictionary-patch.tsv carries the new rows. etymology.tsv did not move, so its archive hash changed and its content hash did not, the repack-only shape. No file was added. See scripts/update-lexicon.ts.
